title: High spatial resolution WRF-Chem modeling in Quito, Ecuador
content:
Environ. Sci.: Adv., 2025, 4,1310-1332
DOI: 10.1039/D5VA00059A, Paper

Gabriela Mancheno, Héctor Jorquera
Advanced air quality modeling is a proper tool to improve urban emissions inventories. This work reports such an approach for the understudied tropical city of Quito, Ecuador.
